disciplines.name: Animalism
disciplines.summary: Extends the Beast's dominion over animals, familiars, territory, and the feral impulses of living beings.

levels.name: Feral Whispers
levels.summary: Communicate with animals and issue simple commands.
levels.duration: Scene; a command may persist up to one night
levels.effect: Communicate with animals the vampire can address and give simple commands appropriate to the animal.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The animal misunderstands and gives false information or follows a twisted version of the command.
rollResults.failure: The animals flee from the vampire's Beast.
rollResults.success: The vampire communicates with the animal and may give a simple command with simple contingencies.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The animal follows the spirit of the command with unusual initiative.

levels.name: Raise Familiar
levels.summary: Raise a drained animal as a loyal undead familiar.
levels.requirement: Feed 1 Vitae to the animal corpse; included in the cost
levels.effect: The corpse rises with Intelligence 1, takes bashing from attacks like a vampire, does not bleed out or decompose, and can receive silent Feral Whispers at any distance. Each additional Vitae renews its duration as if freshly raised.

levels.name: Summon the Hunt
levels.summary: Call predators and scavengers to blood marked prey.
levels.requirement: Spill 1 Vitae on the target; included in the cost
levels.duration: One night or until the blood-marked target is destroyed
levels.effect: Summon all predators/scavengers, or one chosen kind, within a radius determined by successes. Animals that taste the Vitae can receive one shared Feral Whispers command lasting one night per success.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Called animals lash out at the vampire in fear.
rollResults.success: Matching animals answer the call and may receive one shared command.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Animals pursue the command without stopping to eat or sleep.

levels.name: Feral Infection
levels.summary: Spread the Beast's rage through an area.
levels.requirement: Spill 1 Vitae on the ground; included in the cost
levels.effect: Animals smelling the blood enter feral rage. Humans and supernatural beings resist with Resolve + Composure minus the vampire's successes; recent contact with the vampire's blood gives a further penalty. Failed resistance drives victims into frenzy or atavistic violence under broad direction.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire is provoked to frenzy and suffers a penalty to resist it.
rollResults.failure: Affected animals behave strangely but do not enter rage.
rollResults.success: Affected creatures enter feral rage; the vampire may direct them toward a simple target or goal.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The vampire gains the Sated Condition.

levels.name: Lord of the Land
levels.summary: Claim a blood-marked territory and dominate events within it.
levels.requirement: Walk the boundary while marking it with Vitae; the Vitae cost scales with territory size
levels.duration: At least one week per Blood Potency; persists while the vampire remains in the territory
levels.effect: Animals avoid the territory unless invited or controlled. Intruders resist entering/staying and suffer broad penalties unless exceptionally successful. The vampire senses intruders and their rough locations, gains special command over animals and frenzying creatures, and may use raised familiars as remote sensory/command relays.

disciplines.name: Auspex
disciplines.summary: Heightens perception until the vampire can read danger, secrets, objects, minds, and distant places.

levels.name: Beast's Hackles
levels.summary: Ask the Beast about immediate danger or weakness.
levels.cost: First use per scene is free; later uses that scene cost 1 Vitae
levels.effect: Ask one immediate question about danger or weakness; the Beast answers through sensory imagery.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The Storyteller gives false or warped information.
rollResults.failure: The Beast reveals no immediate weakness.
rollResults.success: Ask one appropriate question.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Ask two appropriate questions.

levels.name: Uncanny Perception
levels.summary: Read secrets and weaknesses in one subject.
levels.cost: First use per scene against a target is free; later uses against the same target that scene cost 1 Vitae
levels.effect: Ask questions about the subject's mood, fears, supernatural nature, hidden control, vulnerabilities, and similar secrets.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The Storyteller gives false or misleading information.
rollResults.success: Ask one question per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The answers also provide additional insight.

levels.name: The Spirit's Touch
levels.summary: Read impressions attached to an object or place.
levels.requirement: A particular object can be examined only once per scene
levels.effect: Ask questions about an object's or place's history, ownership, strongest emotions, and associated events.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The Storyteller gives false or misleading information.
rollResults.failure: The subject yields no useful impression.
rollResults.success: Ask one question per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Gain a bonus when using or interacting with the subject for the rest of the scene.

levels.name: Lay Open the Mind
levels.summary: Read and project thoughts and memories.
levels.dicePool: Intelligence + Socialize + Auspex vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Hear the subject's surface thoughts and project thoughts, images, or memories. Deep memories can be dragged up; each additional deep memory after the initial allowance costs Vitae.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire cannot separate thoughts and gains the Confused Condition.
rollResults.success: Establish the mental link for the scene.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Retrieve deep memories up to Auspex dots before paying additional Vitae.

levels.name: Twilight Projection
levels.summary: Project the senses and consciousness outside the body.
levels.effect: The vampire's consciousness travels astrally within the lunar sphere while the body remains corpse-like and vulnerable. Astral Speed is multiplied by Auspex + Blood Potency. The form passes through physical barriers but cannot physically interact or use Disciplines. Each sunrise away costs one temporary Blood Potency; reaching 0 causes Final Death.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The consciousness is displaced far from the intended location.
rollResults.success: The vampire projects and may travel until returning to the body.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The vampire may later spend Vitae reflexively to snap back to the body or the edge of a blocking mystical boundary.

disciplines.name: Celerity
disciplines.summary: Persistent supernatural speed and reflexive bursts fueled by Vitae.
disciplines.cost: None or 1 Vitae per active effect
disciplines.action: None for persistent effects; Reflexive for active effects
disciplines.duration: Permanent for persistent effects; one turn for active effects
disciplines.effect: Persistent: add Celerity to Defense and Dodge; even firearms that deny Defense suffer a penalty equal to Celerity when the vampire can react. Active: each Vitae buys one distinct effect for the turn — jump to the head of Initiative, interrupt another character with a brief action, or multiply Speed by Celerity + 1. No active option may be used more than once per turn.

disciplines.name: Dominate
disciplines.summary: Imposes commands, false memories, and possession through supernatural authority.

levels.name: Mesmerize
levels.summary: Place a victim in a receptive trance.
levels.dicePool: Intelligence + Expression + Dominate vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Mesmerized; while Mesmerized, short direct commands can be issued as instant actions.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim sees through the attempt and gains Steadfast.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Mesmerized.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: A command may be issued in the same action.

levels.name: Iron Edict
levels.summary: Issue a longer command to a Mesmerized victim.
levels.cost: 1 Vitae; free if the victim is in Vinculum with the vampire
levels.duration: Until the task is completed or sunrise
levels.effect: Give up to three sentences of direct instructions; the victim gains Dominated and follows the command.

levels.name: Entombed Command
levels.summary: Plant subconscious triggers for Dominate effects.
levels.cost: None; linked Dominate effects may cost Vitae
levels.duration: One week per success; one month per success if the victim is in Vinculum
levels.effect: Implant one trigger per success. Each trigger activates a specified Mesmerize, Iron Edict, or Lying Mind effect when encountered.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Mesmerized ends and the attempted trigger grants Steadfast when encountered during the next week.
rollResults.success: Implant triggers equal to successes.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Reduce the Vitae cost of implanted Iron Edict and Lying Mind by one.

levels.name: The Lying Mind
levels.summary: Permanently rewrite or suppress memories.
levels.requirement: Victim has Mesmerized and consumes or is anointed with 1 Vitae included in the cost
levels.effect: Create, erase, or alter memories and inflict Amnesia or False Memories as appropriate. Entombed Command can make the change conditional on a trigger.

levels.name: Possession
levels.summary: Take control of another person's body.
levels.effect: Use the victim's body, Physical Attributes, Skills, and Physical/Combat Merits. The vampire's own body lies in a torpor-like state. Disciplines and Blood Sorcery are unavailable while possessing another body.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Mesmerized ends and the victim regains Willpower.
rollResults.success: Possess the victim for one night per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Regain Willpower when leaving the body.

disciplines.name: Majesty
disciplines.summary: Turns supernatural presence into fascination, trust, jealousy, loyalty, and worship.

levels.name: Awe
levels.summary: Become the unquestioned center of attention.
levels.effect: Ignore Social penalties from appearance or behavior, add Majesty to Presence rolls in normal interaction, and penalize others' attempts to notice anything else.

levels.name: Confidant
levels.summary: Create intimate trust in someone already affected by Awe.
levels.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Majesty vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Charmed.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire gains Swooning for the victim.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Charmed.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Charmed lasts nights rather than hours.

levels.name: Green Eyes
levels.summary: Manipulate the emotions and obsessive loyalty of Charmed or Enthralled victims.
levels.effect: Shift affected victims into intense emotional states and leverage Charmed/Enthralled loyalty for requests. Charmed victims stop before lethal harm or breaking points; Enthralled victims tolerate far more.

levels.name: Loyalty
levels.summary: Turn affection into fanatical devotion.
levels.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Majesty vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Enthralled.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim resolves Charmed.
rollResults.failure: The victim remains Charmed but not Enthralled.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Enthralled.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Enthralled lasts one week per Blood Potency.

levels.name: Idol
levels.summary: Elevate Awe into near-worship across a scene.
levels.effect: Enhance Awe. Affected people must overcome Resolve + Blood Potency minus Majesty to harm or embarrass the vampire; Charmed victims may become Enthralled for the scene.

disciplines.name: Nightmare
disciplines.summary: Weaponizes the supernatural terror inspired by the Beast.

levels.name: Dread Presence
levels.summary: Radiate an unsettling aura and conjure brief frightening illusions.
levels.effect: Add Nightmare to mundane Intimidation, prevent affected victims from spending Willpower offensively, and create small short-lived illusions affecting up to two senses.

levels.name: Face of the Beast
levels.summary: Magnify a victim's fear until they flee.
levels.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Nightmare vs. Composure + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Frightened.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim faces the fear and regains Willpower.
rollResults.failure: Fear troubles the victim but does not drive them away.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Frightened.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The vampire learns precisely what the victim fears.

levels.name: The Grand Delusion
levels.summary: Implant a frightening false belief.
levels.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Nightmare vs. Composure + Blood Potency
levels.effect: Inflict Delusional with a belief defined by the vampire, within limits.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire gains Delusional based on the intended false belief.
rollResults.success: The victim gains Delusional for the normal duration; Dread Presence extends it by Blood Potency.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The delusion lasts three nights, or longer with Dread Presence.

levels.name: Waking Nightmare
levels.summary: Create a multi-sensory nightmare hallucination.
levels.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + Nightmare vs. highest Composure + Blood Potency in group
levels.effect: Create one terrifying alteration or addition perceived across all senses. With Dread Presence it can affect everyone present.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The vampire hallucinates and must resist frenzy.
rollResults.success: The hallucination lasts a scene.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The hallucination lasts a full night.

levels.name: Mortal Terror
levels.summary: Turn an existing fear into lethal supernatural terror.
levels.effect: Deal lethal damage per success and inflict Broken if the victim survives. Dread Presence can also strip Composure temporarily.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim gains a strong bonus to resist Nightmare for the next week.
rollResults.failure: The victim suffers fear but no mechanical harm.
rollResults.success: Deal one lethal damage per success and inflict Broken if the victim survives.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: If the victim dies, the vampire regains Willpower.

disciplines.name: Obfuscate
disciplines.summary: Erases the vampire, companions, objects, and places from attention and memory.

levels.name: Face in the Crowd
levels.summary: Become unremarkable and easy to overlook.
levels.effect: Observers ignore and poorly remember the vampire unless the vampire draws attention. Actions that would draw notice prompt Wits + Composure penalized by Obfuscate.

levels.name: Touch of Shadow
levels.summary: Hide an object or animal from notice.
levels.requirement: Touch the subject; unwilling targets require a touch attack; normal Size limit is the vampire's Size
levels.effect: Apply Face in the Crowd-like occlusion to an object or animal.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The subject becomes conspicuous.
rollResults.success: The subject fades from active notice.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The subject also fails to stand out in photographs or video recorded while the power was active.

levels.name: Cloak of Night
levels.summary: Vanish completely and extend Obfuscate to people.
levels.effect: Touch of Shadow may affect people. Spending Vitae with Face in the Crowd makes the vampire disappear completely; indirect tracking remains possible.

levels.name: The Familiar Stranger
levels.summary: Appear as a subjective or specific expected identity.
levels.effect: When using Face in the Crowd or Touch of Shadow on a person, project a chosen identity or subjective archetype. Objects can likewise be visually redefined within similar Size.

levels.name: Oubliette
levels.summary: Turn a blood-marked haven into a large-scale Obfuscate domain.
levels.requirement: Mark the area's boundaries, gateways, exits, and landmarks with Vitae and sleep a full day there
levels.effect: Use Touch of Shadow, Cloak of Night, and Familiar Stranger at any distance within the haven and affect multiple subjects with a single activation; associated extra Vitae costs are reduced as described by the power.

disciplines.name: Protean
disciplines.summary: Reshapes the vampire through earth, animal adaptations, full forms, and monstrous transformation.

levels.name: Unmarked Grave
levels.summary: Merge with earth or solid material to rest safely.
levels.cost: 0 in soil/earth; otherwise Vitae equal to material Durability
levels.requirement: Hiding place at least the vampire's Size
levels.effect: Merge with the ground, remain mostly insulated from the outside world, retain limited Kindred senses, absorb blood spilled above, and take bashing as the shelter loses Structure.

levels.name: Predatory Aspect
levels.summary: Manifest three chosen predatory adaptations.
levels.effect: Manifest any or all of three stored adaptations. Stored adaptations can be changed by spending a day in Unmarked Grave and Vitae per replacement.

levels.name: Beast's Skin
levels.summary: Assume stored forms of consumed predatory animals.
levels.effect: Use a stored animal's Physical Attributes, Skills, Size, Speed, Health, senses, locomotion, and natural attacks. Store up to Protean dots in forms.

levels.name: Unnatural Aspect
levels.summary: Add one monstrous adaptation when using Predatory Aspect.
levels.effect: Add one stored monstrous adaptation such as Barbed Hands, Hooked Hands, Horrid Talons, Rubbery Flesh, or Wings. Change the stored choice after a full day/night in Unmarked Grave and two Vitae.

levels.name: Primeval Miasma
levels.summary: Dissolve into a predatory cloud of smoke.
levels.effect: Become a mobile smoke cloud immune to physical harm except fire, sunlight, and damaging banes; move through non-airtight barriers, retain Kindred senses, feed from open wounds, and sleep in this form like Unmarked Grave.

disciplines.name: Resilience
disciplines.summary: Persistent supernatural toughness with active damage mitigation.
disciplines.cost: None or 1 Vitae per active effect
disciplines.action: None for persistent effects; Reflexive for active effects
disciplines.duration: Permanent for persistent effects; one turn for active effects
disciplines.effect: Persistent: add Resilience to Stamina and downgrade one aggravated damage per Resilience dot to lethal from most sources, including fire and acquired banes but not sunlight. Active: each Vitae buys one distinct effect for the turn — reduce non-bane damage by Resilience + 1, or reduce fire/acquired-bane damage by Resilience. Sunlight is never reduced by Resilience.

disciplines.name: Vigor
disciplines.summary: Persistent supernatural strength with active bursts of destructive force.
disciplines.cost: None or 1 Vitae per active effect
disciplines.action: None for persistent effects; Reflexive for active effects
disciplines.duration: Permanent for persistent effects; one turn for active effects
disciplines.effect: Persistent: add Vigor to Strength and multiply jump distance by Vigor + 1. Active: each Vitae buys one distinct effect for the turn — add Vigor as weapon bonus to Athletics/Brawl/Weaponry attacks, or lift and hurl otherwise unwieldy objects using the Discipline's improvised-weapon rules.

ritualDisciplines.name: Crúac
ritualDisciplines.statusRequirement: Circle of the Crone Status • to learn new Crúac or rites
ritualDisciplines.summary: Ritual Discipline of the Circle of the Crone. Each purchased dot normally grants one free rite, and known rites cannot exceed the Crúac rating.
ritualDisciplines.cost: Rites cost Vitae equal to rite rating before the casting roll
ritualDisciplines.action: Extended; base interval 30 minutes per roll, 15 minutes when Crúac exceeds the rite rating
ritualDisciplines.effect: The unmodified casting pool determines the maximum number of rolls. Rituals fail if interrupted. Standard blood-sorcery roll results and ritual-specific contested/resisted defenses apply.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The ritual fails completely and the sacrifice is lost. Crúac grants Tempted; Theban Sorcery grants Humbled. The next ritual attempted suffers a –2 dice penalty.
rollResults.failure: No successes are accumulated. The ritualist may abandon the ritual or continue; continuing inflicts the Stumbled Condition.
rollResults.success: Accumulate successes. When the ritual's target number of successes is reached, its effect takes place immediately.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: In addition to accumulating successes, choose one: reduce the target successes by the Ritual Discipline dots; reduce the interval to 15 minutes (or 5 minutes if the Discipline exceeds the ritual rating); or gain Ecstatic (Crúac) / Raptured (Theban Sorcery) if the ritual succeeds.

suggestedModifiers.situation: Power targets or applies to a vampire with existing blood sympathy; Crúac doubles this modifier.
The ritualist is rushed or distracted; multiple distractions are cumulative.
The ritualist prepares an elaborate ritual beyond the minimum sacrifice.
Theban only: successful meditation; bonus equals meditation successes.
Crúac only: extra Vitae sacrificed beyond the requirement; bonus equals excess Vitae.

ritualDisciplines.name: Theban Sorcery
ritualDisciplines.statusRequirement: Lancea et Sanctum Status • to learn new Theban Sorcery or miracles
ritualDisciplines.summary: Ritual Discipline of the Lancea et Sanctum. Each purchased dot normally grants one free miracle, and known miracles cannot exceed the Theban rating.
ritualDisciplines.cost: 1 Willpower plus the miracle's sacrament before the casting roll
ritualDisciplines.action: Extended; base interval 30 minutes per roll, 15 minutes when Theban Sorcery exceeds the miracle rating
ritualDisciplines.effect: The unmodified casting pool determines the maximum number of rolls. Rituals fail if interrupted. The caster's Humanity must be at least the miracle's rating.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The ritual fails completely and the sacrifice is lost. Crúac grants Tempted; Theban Sorcery grants Humbled. The next ritual attempted suffers a –2 dice penalty.
rollResults.failure: No successes are accumulated. The ritualist may abandon the ritual or continue; continuing inflicts the Stumbled Condition.
rollResults.success: Accumulate successes. When the ritual's target number of successes is reached, its effect takes place immediately.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: In addition to accumulating successes, choose one: reduce the target successes by the Ritual Discipline dots; reduce the interval to 15 minutes (or 5 minutes if the Discipline exceeds the ritual rating); or gain Ecstatic (Crúac) / Raptured (Theban Sorcery) if the ritual succeeds.

suggestedModifiers.situation: Power targets or applies to a vampire with existing blood sympathy; Crúac doubles this modifier.
The ritualist is rushed or distracted; multiple distractions are cumulative.
The ritualist prepares an elaborate ritual beyond the minimum sacrifice.
Theban only: successful meditation; bonus equals meditation successes.
Crúac only: extra Vitae sacrificed beyond the requirement; bonus equals excess Vitae.

devotions.name: Body of Will
devotions.summary: Ignore wound penalties briefly and turn new injuries into free Vigor activations.
devotions.effect: For the duration, ignore wound penalties; on turns when damage is taken, one Vigor effect may be activated without Vitae.

devotions.name: Chain of Command
devotions.summary: Plant one Dominate effect in a victim for later use against a designated subject.
devotions.dicePool: Intelligence + Persuasion + Dominate vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, the victim carries one specified Dominate effect and later uses it with the vampire's dice pool.

devotions.name: Cloak the Gathering
devotions.summary: Extend Obfuscate to a group within the vampire's aura.
devotions.effect: Expand Touch of Shadow to up to Blood Potency people nearby; extra Vitae can apply Cloak of Night to the whole group.

devotions.name: Conditioning
devotions.summary: Erode a Mesmerized victim's will over repeated sessions.
devotions.requirement: Victim has Mesmerized; same victim only once every two nights
devotions.dicePool: Wits + Subterfuge + Dominate vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Repeated successes build Subservient marks across Willpower until the victim becomes Enslaved.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: Mesmerized ends and the victim retains the normal resistance bonus.
rollResults.success: Apply Subservient.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Apply an extra Subservient mark.

devotions.name: Cross-Contamination
devotions.summary: Blend awe and terror into a disorienting emotional aura.
devotions.dicePool: Presence + Empathy + lower of Majesty or Nightmare
devotions.effect: Reduce effective Composure by one, make looking away require a contested roll, and remove 10-again from resistance to Persuasion/Intimidation Social Maneuvering. Cannot coexist with Awe or Dread Presence.

devotions.name: Cult of Personality
devotions.summary: Broadcast Loyalty across a crowd.
devotions.effect: Anyone present whose Composure + Blood Potency is lower than the vampire's successes gains Enthralled.

devotions.name: Enchantment
devotions.summary: Redirect Loyalty to another person, place, or object.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: Works as Loyalty, but the source of Enthralled may be a communicated alternate person, place, or object.

devotions.name: Enfeebling Aura
devotions.summary: Trade Majesty dots to suppress a victim's physical Disciplines for the scene.
devotions.dicePool: Presence + Intimidation + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, sacrifice Majesty dots one-for-one to remove up to successes total dots from the target's Celerity, Resilience, and Vigor.

devotions.name: Foul Grave
devotions.summary: Project predatory aura while resting in an Unmarked Grave.
devotions.effect: Gain limited awareness of nearby mortals and Kindred while interred and activate predatory aura normally from the grave.

devotions.name: Force of Nature
devotions.summary: Assume multiple Protean advantages and redistribute Physical Attributes.
devotions.effect: Gain as many Predatory Aspect, Beast's Skin, and Unnatural Aspect advantages as desired without their Vitae costs; adaptations can change reflexively. An instant action may shift up to Protean dots among Physical Attributes.

devotions.name: Gargoyle's Vigilance
devotions.summary: Gain complete vigilance over a haven while remaining still.
devotions.requirement: Remain stationary for at least ten minutes in a Safe Place
devotions.effect: Project Auspex from any point in the haven, gain a major bonus to detect intruders, gain an Initiative bonus when moving against one, and activate Resilience without Vitae. Willpower allows use while sleeping.

devotions.name: Hint of Fear
devotions.summary: Use Face of the Beast as a rapid reflexive glance.
devotions.cost: 1 Vitae plus Face of the Beast's cost
devotions.dicePool: None; roll Face of the Beast normally
devotions.effect: Face of the Beast becomes reflexive and may be subtle if the vampire does not designate herself as the fear's source.

devotions.name: Juggernaut's Gait
devotions.summary: Become briefly immune to all damage.
devotions.effect: Take no damage from any source, including fire and sunlight, while maintained. The Vitae may be prepared across previous turns subject to normal expenditure limits.

devotions.name: Quicken Sight
devotions.summary: Perceive fast events in slow motion and react accordingly.
devotions.effect: Read and inspect very fast events, apply Defense to ranged attacks, and gain the benefit of aiming immediately.

devotions.name: Reason's Salon
devotions.summary: Suppress predatory aggression within a prepared gathering place.
devotions.effect: Within the prepared location, vampires suffer the user's Resilience as a penalty to predatory aura rolls and gain the same value as a bonus to resist frenzy.

devotions.name: Riot
devotions.summary: Drive a wide area into selfish, destructive bedlam.
devotions.effect: Characters in a large area whose Composure + Blood Potency is below the vampire's successes gain Bestial, Competitive, and Wanton. Use is a Humanity 1 breaking point.

devotions.name: Shared Sight
devotions.summary: Temporarily lend Auspex dots to another person.
devotions.effect: Transfer up to successes Auspex dots. The borrower uses their own Attributes/Skills; the lender loses that many dice from Auspex rolls for the duration.

devotions.name: Shatter the Shroud
devotions.summary: Destroy a concealment effect after winning a Clash of Wills.
devotions.effect: When the vampire wins a Clash of Wills to pierce hiding, the opposing concealment ends immediately.

devotions.name: Stalwart Servant
devotions.summary: Lend Resilience through Vitae to a servant.
devotions.effect: After feeding, the subject gains the vampire's Resilience dots if lower than the vampire's rating, including passive benefits and one Vitae to activate it. Subjects maintained at once are limited by Blood Potency.

devotions.name: Subsume the Lesser Beast
devotions.summary: Project the vampire's mind into a predatory or scavenging animal.
devotions.requirement: Feed 1 Vitae to the animal; included in the cost
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Animal Ken + Animalism – animal Resolve
devotions.effect: Take over the animal's body while the vampire's body lies torpor-like. Use the animal's Physical traits and abilities; normal Disciplines/Blood Sorcery are unavailable.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The animal rejects control and the vampire suffers animalistic tics and Social penalties for the night.
rollResults.success: Control lasts one night per success.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Auspex remains available while inhabiting the animal.

devotions.name: Summoning (Dominate)
devotions.summary: Compel a previously Mesmerized subject to travel to the vampire.
devotions.requirement: Mesmerized the victim within the last year
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Persuasion + Dominate vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: The subject knows where the vampire is and feels compelled to travel there by the most direct practical means.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim actively avoids the vampire.
rollResults.success: The compulsion lasts through the vampire's current night.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The compulsion continues through the following day and night.

devotions.name: Summoning (Majesty)
devotions.summary: Compel a previous subject of Awe to travel to the vampire.
devotions.requirement: Used Awe on the victim within the last year
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Persuasion + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: The subject knows where the vampire is and feels compelled to travel there by the most direct practical means.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The victim actively avoids the vampire.
rollResults.success: The compulsion lasts through the vampire's current night.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: The compulsion continues through the following day and night.

devotions.name: Sun's Brutal Dreamscape
devotions.summary: Make a sleeping Kindred victim share the vampire's sunlight wounds.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Nightmare vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: While active, a touched sleeping Kindred takes every sunlight wound the vampire takes; awakening from this damage also inflicts Frightened.

devotions.name: Touch of Deprivation
devotions.summary: Temporarily deny a touched victim one sense or one known Auspex ability.
devotions.dicePool: Intelligence + Medicine + Auspex vs. Resolve + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, suppress one chosen sense or a known Auspex ability for the scene.

devotions.name: Undying Familiar
devotions.summary: Make a living ghouled animal rise under Raise Familiar when killed.
devotions.effect: Activate together with Raise Familiar while feeding a living animal. While it remains ghouled, death immediately raises it; its undead duration is measured in weeks rather than nights.

devotions.name: Wet Dream
devotions.summary: Seed a sleeping victim with intertwined fear and desire.
devotions.dicePool: Manipulation + Empathy + Majesty vs. Composure + Blood Potency
devotions.effect: On success, the victim's next sleep inflicts both Spooked and Swooning, with subjects chosen by the vampire; resolving both grants only one Beat.

devotions.name: The Wish
devotions.summary: Temporarily exalt a consenting mortal before binding them in lasting enthrallment.
devotions.requirement: Mortal target freely agrees and feeds from the vampire; usable once per character
devotions.effect: Grant Celerity 2, Vigor 2, Majesty 3 usable with Willpower instead of Vitae, and remove normal need for sleep/food/water. At the end, the mortal gains Persistent Enthralled.

devotions.name: Vermin Flood
devotions.summary: Call a destructive plague of small animals over a prepared area.
devotions.requirement: Spread Vitae over an area no larger than a small house or alley
devotions.effect: Every Size 2-or-less animal swarms the area with persistent Celerity/Vigor benefits. Everything except the vampire takes lethal damage equal to Animalism each turn, ignoring mundane armor; movement in the swarm is halved.

devotions.name: Wraith's Presence
devotions.summary: Project a false image elsewhere while using Cloak of Night.
devotions.effect: Project a mostly still, silent image of the chosen subject at a visible location. Touch dispels it; otherwise supernatural piercing uses Clash of Wills.

cruacRites.name: Pangs of Proserpina
cruacRites.summary: Provoke supernatural hunger in a distant victim.
cruacRites.effect: A victim within one mile counts as starving for the next frenzy-resistance roll, regardless of recent feeding.

cruacRites.name: Rigor Mortis
cruacRites.summary: Suppress the reanimating force of a vampire's Vitae.
cruacRites.effect: A vampire victim within one mile suffers –3 dice on the next physical action.

cruacRites.name: Cheval
cruacRites.summary: See and hear through a touched subject.
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist sees and hears what the subject does regardless of distance.

cruacRites.name: The Hydra's Vitae
cruacRites.summary: Curse the ritualist's own blood into poison.
cruacRites.effect: Vampires/Strix drinking the ritualist's blood take lethal per Vitae and gain no nourishment; mortals/ghouls take heavier lethal damage.

cruacRites.name: Deflection of Wooden Doom
cruacRites.effect: All attempts to stake the ritualist fail.

cruacRites.name: Touch of the Morrigan
cruacRites.summary: Charge the ritualist's touch with lethal force.
cruacRites.duration: Until first use or next sunrise
cruacRites.effect: The first successful touch attack inflicts lethal damage equal to ritual Potency and ends the rite.

cruacRites.name: Blood Price
cruacRites.summary: Redirect blood consumed by a subject to the ritualist.
cruacRites.effect: Whenever the subject drinks blood, up to ritual Potency Vitae go to the ritualist first; excess remains with the subject.

cruacRites.name: Willful Vitae
cruacRites.summary: Prevent new Vinculum and blood addiction for the night.
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist is immune to new Vinculum and blood addiction; existing bonds/addiction remain.

cruacRites.name: Blood Blight
cruacRites.summary: Mystically destroy blood or Vitae in a victim.
cruacRites.effect: Mortals take ritual Potency lethal damage; Kindred, Strix, and ghouls lose ritual Potency Vitae, usually provoking hunger frenzy checks in Kindred.

cruacRites.name: Feeding the Crone
cruacRites.summary: Transform feeding into a savage supernatural bite.
cruacRites.duration: Until next sunrise or cancelled with 1 Vitae
cruacRites.effect: The ritualist gains no Vitae from feeding but the bite deals +2 aggravated damage.

thebanMiracles.name: Blood Scourge
thebanMiracles.summary: Create a temporary whip of Vitae.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: At least 1 Vitae of the ritualist's own blood
thebanMiracles.duration: Until sunrise; created whip lasts until scene end
thebanMiracles.effect: Create a 2L Vitae whip at any point before sunrise.

thebanMiracles.name: Vitae Reliquary
thebanMiracles.summary: Store Vitae in a sacramental object.
thebanMiracles.effect: Transfer up to ritual Potency Vitae into the object. Vampires, Strix, or ghouls can later retrieve it; normal bond/addiction risks apply.

thebanMiracles.name: Blandishment of Sin
thebanMiracles.summary: Upgrade the next bashing damage a distant victim suffers.
thebanMiracles.effect: The next bashing damage from one attack becomes lethal. A separate four-dot version with 8 target successes upgrades lethal to aggravated.

thebanMiracles.name: Curse of Babel
thebanMiracles.summary: Prevent a victim from speaking or writing.
thebanMiracles.effect: A victim within one mile cannot speak or write.

thebanMiracles.name: Liar's Plague
thebanMiracles.summary: Punish a present victim for telling falsehoods.
thebanMiracles.effect: If the victim lies during the next scene, beetles swarm from the victim's mouth.

thebanMiracles.name: Malediction of Despair
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A lock of the victim's hair
thebanMiracles.duration: Until triggered or one lunar month
thebanMiracles.effect: The next time the victim performs the specified action, suffer –5 dice once.

thebanMiracles.name: Gift of Lazarus
thebanMiracles.summary: Animate a human corpse as a servant.
thebanMiracles.sacrament: A communion wafer under the corpse's tongue
thebanMiracles.effect: Raise a corpse retaining its former Skills but no Willpower; age of corpse degrades Attributes. It is destroyed by enough aggravated damage or when the miracle expires.

thebanMiracles.name: Stigmata
thebanMiracles.effect: Mortals take one lethal per turn; vampires and ghouls lose one Vitae per turn, then take lethal if a vampire reaches zero Vitae.

thebanMiracles.name: Transubstantiation
thebanMiracles.summary: Transform one present substance, creature, or person into another form.
thebanMiracles.effect: Transform a subject no larger than the ritualist without creating intelligence or directly healing/harming it; existing injuries remain and the change reverses at sunrise.

coils.name: Coil of the Ascendant
coils.summary: Transcends daysleep, fire, and sunlight through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Surmounting the Daysleep
levels.summary: Remain active by day more easily while Blush of Life is active.
levels.effect: While benefiting from Blush of Life, no roll is required to resist daysleep and remaining active by day does not inflict Lethargic.

ruleEffects.condition: Blush of Life active during daytime

levels.name: The Warm Face
levels.summary: Extend Blush of Life to a full day.
levels.effect: Blush of Life lasts 24 hours rather than one scene.

levels.name: Conquer the Red Fear
levels.summary: Fire and sunlight no longer provoke frenzy.
levels.effect: Exposure to fire or sunlight does not trigger frenzy, though damage still applies normally.

levels.name: Peace with the Flame
levels.summary: Downgrade fire damage while Blush of Life is active.
levels.effect: While Blush of Life is active, fire deals lethal rather than aggravated. Each Resilience dot can further downgrade one point of that fire damage from lethal to bashing.

ruleEffects.value: one lethal → bashing per Resilience dot

levels.name: Sun's Forgotten Kiss
levels.summary: Spend extra Vitae with Blush of Life to slow sunlight damage intervals.
levels.cost: Additional Vitae when activating Blush of Life
levels.effect: Each extra Vitae makes Blood Potency count one lower for sunlight damage interval only, minimum effective Blood Potency 1.

ruleEffects.value: 1 per extra Vitae spent with Blush of Life

coils.name: Coil of the Wyrm
coils.summary: Refines and directs the Beast through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Stir the Beast
levels.summary: Enter a voluntary frenzy with a declared objective.
levels.effect: Enter frenzy voluntarily and name a short goal. Escaping before the goal is met suffers a penalty; the frenzy ends when the goal is no longer pressing or possible.

levels.name: Beast's Hunger
levels.summary: Increase effective Blood Potency for senses and predatory aura while frenzying.
levels.effect: During any frenzy, add the current Coil of the Wyrm rating to Blood Potency for Kindred senses and predatory aura.

levels.name: Leash the Beast
levels.summary: Ride the Wave without Willpower and with a Coil bonus.
levels.effect: Riding the Wave no longer costs Willpower and gains the Coil of the Wyrm rating as bonus dice.

levels.name: Beast's Power
levels.summary: Surrender fully to frenzy for major physical bonuses.
levels.effect: When entering frenzy, the Dragon may forgo resistance until the Beast is sated; during that frenzy add Blood Potency to Defense, Health, and Speed.

levels.name: Eternal Frenzy
levels.summary: Remain frenzying despite lethal wounds that would normally force torpor.
levels.effect: While in frenzy, filling Health with lethal damage does not cause torpor. If frenzy ends while Health is still full of lethal, torpor begins immediately; frenzy may persist across scenes.

coils.name: Coil of the Voivode
coils.summary: Transforms Vitae addiction, blood sympathy, blood bonds, and the Embrace.

levels.name: Taste of Fealty
levels.summary: Make the Dragon's Vitae exceptionally addictive and uniquely satisfying.
levels.effect: Each point of the Dragon's Vitae counts as two for Vitae addiction; addicts can resolve blood-addiction Deprived only with Vitae from someone possessing this Coil.

levels.name: Into the Fold
levels.summary: Create blood sympathy with blood-bound subjects.
levels.effect: The Dragon and blood-bound subjects gain blood sympathy with closeness based on bond stage.

ruleEffects.value: stage 1 = four-times removed; stage 2 = three-times removed; stage 3 = twice removed

levels.name: Call to Serve
levels.summary: Accelerate a new blood bond with extra Vitae.
levels.effect: Three Vitae in one brief feeding can establish stage two; five Vitae can establish stage three. This expenditure ignores the normal Vitae-per-turn limit.

levels.name: Voivode Undisputed
levels.summary: Turn blood sympathy into resistance instead of vulnerability.
levels.effect: Blood sympathy gives no Discipline bonus against the Dragon; the Dragon adds her blood-sympathy bonus to resist blood bonds and contest predatory aura from those she has bound.

ruleEffects.value: blood-sympathy attack bonus removed against Dragon

levels.name: The Vast Dynasty
levels.summary: Replace automatic Humanity loss from Embrace with a lower breaking point.
levels.effect: Embracing no longer automatically costs Humanity. It becomes a Humanity 3 breaking point, with +1 die to avoid detachment.

ruleEffects.value: Humanity 3 breaking point; +1 die to detachment

scales.name: Day-Wake Conditioning
scales.summary: Reverse a vampire subject's sleep cycle while the conditioning is maintained.
scales.procedure: Force a vampire to resist daysleep until resistance falls to a chance die, then allow sleep only at dusk in a brightly lit chamber.
scales.outcome: The subject wakes at dawn and sleeps at night indefinitely while continuing to sleep in bright light each night; more than two consecutive nights without doing so ends the effect.

scales.name: Epidermal Shielding Bath
scales.summary: Temporarily improve a Kindred subject's effective Humanity against sunlight.
scales.procedure: Submerge a Kindred in an alchemical bath for one hour while Vitae is bled into the mixture.
scales.outcome: For 24 hours, each Vitae invested increases effective Humanity by one for sunlight damage only.

scales.name: Flesh Graft Treatment
scales.summary: Temporarily make grievous wounds easier to heal.
scales.procedure: Prepare mortal skin grafts in fresh human blood, bind them over damaged areas, and inject very fresh human blood.
scales.outcome: Kindred can heal aggravated damage with Vitae as though it were lethal. Mortals can heal lethal with Vitae supplied in the treatment; this may create a blood bond/ghoul.

scales.name: Augmented Vitae Draught
scales.summary: Bottle a Physical Intensity augmentation for a mortal.
scales.procedure: Use sterilized needles and tubing, then trigger Physical Intensity so the spent Vitae drains into a sealed vessel.
scales.outcome: The stored Vitae remains potent for Blood Potency hours. A mortal drinking it gains the physical augmentation for a scene, then takes bashing damage equal to twice the Vitae invested and develops blood addiction.

scales.name: Kindred Sense Endowment
scales.summary: Grant a mortal temporary vampire-like blood senses.
scales.procedure: Prepare and distill a blood-and-bone mixture, apply it to the subject's eyes and nose, and have the subject ingest the remainder.
scales.outcome: For about 24 hours the mortal senses blood as though Blood Potency 2 and develops a dangerous hunger for human blood.

scales.name: Surgical Heart Removal
scales.summary: Remove a Kindred subject's heart through a reversible but dangerous operation.
scales.procedure: Perform a six-hour surgery: extended Intelligence + Medicine, 10 successes, one-hour interval. Reversal uses the same roll.
scales.outcome: On success the subject cannot be staked and cannot gain Vitae from feeding, but can still spend stored Vitae or gain it from blood sorcery. Destroying the body eventually regenerates it from the heart; destroying the heart kills the subject.

rollResults.dramaticFailure: The heart is destroyed; the subject frenzies and reaches Final Death at scene end.
rollResults.failure: The subject falls into torpor as if staked until the heart is restored.
rollResults.success: Heart removal succeeds with the listed consequences.
rollResults.exceptionalSuccess: Normal extended-action exceptional-success benefit only.

scales.name: Blood Cleansing Ritual
scales.summary: Attempt to remove an existing blood bond.
scales.procedure: Prepare an animal-blood and viscera wash mixed with several Vitae and repeatedly force it through the restrained subject's nose and mouth.
scales.outcome: For each Vitae invested, roll Dragon Blood Potency minus the bond creator's Blood Potency; any success permanently removes the bond. The Dragon's Vitae in the wash does not create a new bond.

scales.name: Fealty's Reward
scales.summary: Create an unusually enduring ghoul from a stage-three bound mortal.
scales.procedure: Drain a stage-three blood-bound mortal to the last Health box, collect the Dragon's gained Vitae, have the subject drink it, then rest 48 hours.
scales.outcome: The subject becomes a ghoul for one year rather than one month, renewable only by the Dragon. If the state expires, the ghoul dies and later rises as a draugr.

scales.name: Mass Embrace
scales.summary: Embrace a prepared group through one collective procedure.
scales.procedure: Gather mortals in a basin-like space, bleed out the Dragon's Vitae, drain the subjects into the pool, drink from the pooled blood, and inject it into the corpses.
scales.outcome: Subjects rise at Blood Potency 1 with one Vitae. Each makes a chance die: success = control, failure = immediate frenzy, dramatic failure = draugr. The Dragon loses Humanity as with an ordinary Embrace.

scales.name: Sanguinary Invigoration
scales.summary: Prepare a living vessel so much higher-Blood-Potency vampires can feed from it.
scales.procedure: Mix one extracted Vitae with arcane ingredients and inject the fresh preparation into a living human or animal within ten minutes.
scales.outcome: For one week, the Dragon treats Blood Potency as four lower when checking whether she can feed from the subject and four higher for smelling the subject's blood. The subject is not blood-bound or addicted by the injection itself.
